# RecreationPrompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser drawing game called Pastel Neon Doodle District. The player starts in a gallery, taps a large mobile CTA to create a 9:16 canvas, drags one thumb to draw freehand neon lines, picks pastel ink colors, places decora/anime-lofi stickers, changes the paper-city mood, saves to a local gallery, and can reopen saved canvases. Keep the mechanics calm and non-punitive: no timer, no fail state, no score pressure. The presentation should be a satirical anime lo-fi neon city sketchbook with soft girl pastel dream colors, decora kei motifs, search-visible drawing game language, and meme-tone cues like bestie and era. Use browser-native CSS/Canvas/JS, mobile-safe bottom controls, readable portrait HUD, procedural skyline/grid/moon background, and lightweight catalog-backed fonts/audio/GIF feedback.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first creative canvas / meme maker drawing game.
- objective: create a project, draw freehand strokes on a portrait canvas, add visual layers such as stickers/effects/moods, save the project, and return to a gallery of saved canvases.
- input model: one-thumb pointer/touch/click flow; tap create/open/save/back/tool buttons; drag on the canvas to draw freehand line segments; tap tool choices in a bottom sheet.
- core loop: gallery -> create or open canvas -> choose drawing/deco tools -> draw or place decorative elements -> save to localStorage -> gallery thumbnail persists progress.
- fail/friction state: no win/loss state; friction is empty-gallery onboarding, accidental clearing, media/audio browser limits, and mobile tap readability.

## Protected mechanics
- Gallery/editor two-state flow and saved project persistence in browser localStorage.
- Portrait 9:16 drawing canvas, one-thumb tool buttons, and drag-to-draw freehand stroke semantics.
- Tool selection for color/decorative additions/background mood and save/back navigation.
- Canvas coordinate mapping from visible CSS size to logical portrait canvas size.
- Non-timed, relaxing creative session design with no failure punishment.

## Remixed target
Pastel Neon Doodle District is a satirical anime lo-fi neon city drawing game. The player is a calm-city doodler who traces tiny soft-girl neon lines over a procedural city sketchbook, adds decora stickers, changes city moods, and saves the result as a public-facing anti-anxiety drawing puzzle vignette. Mechanics remain the same as the source creative maker; the world, HUD language, background ownership, focal identity, feedback, and mobile hierarchy are regenerated around drawing-game search hooks, pastel dream aesthetics, and bestie/era meme tone.
